# Generated by the Niobium FHE Application Design AI Assistant (FHEanna).
#
# The client stages (keygen, encrypt, decrypt) and diabetes_compute_sdk, all
# built against the OpenFHE and libnbfhetch that the niobium-client submodule
# builds. Run scripts/build_task.sh: it builds the client, then configures this
# file with
#   cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=<repo>/niobium-client/vendor/lib/openfhe
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(encrypted_diabetes_risk CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release)
endif()

find_package(OpenFHE CONFIG QUIET)
if(NOT OpenFHE_FOUND)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "This CMakeLists builds against the niobium-client's own OpenFHE only "
        "(run scripts/build_task.sh).")
endif()
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} ${OpenFHE_CXX_FLAGS}")

set(OPENFHE_INCLUDES
    ${OpenFHE_INCLUDE}
    ${OpenFHE_INCLUDE}/third-party/include
    ${OpenFHE_INCLUDE}/core
    ${OpenFHE_INCLUDE}/pke
    ${OpenFHE_INCLUDE}/binfhe)

set(SRC_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src")
set(STAGES keygen encrypt decrypt)

# ── niobium-client SDK ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
set(NB_CLIENT_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/niobium-client"
    CACHE PATH "niobium-client checkout, built with 'make release'")
set(NB_FHETCH_DIR "${NB_CLIENT_DIR}/vendor/niobium-fhetch")

find_library(NBFHETCH_LIB NAMES nbfhetch
    PATHS "${NB_CLIENT_DIR}/build/vendor/niobium-fhetch"
          "${NB_CLIENT_DIR}/build/_deps/niobium-fhetch-build" NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
if(NOT NBFHETCH_LIB)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "libnbfhetch not found under ${NB_CLIENT_DIR}/build -- "
                        "run scripts/build_task.sh")
endif()
get_filename_component(NBFHETCH_LIBDIR "${NBFHETCH_LIB}" DIRECTORY)
set(CMAKE_BUILD_RPATH "${OpenFHE_LIBDIR};${NBFHETCH_LIBDIR}")
message(STATUS "SDK build: OpenFHE ${OpenFHE_INCLUDE}, nbfhetch ${NBFHETCH_LIB}")

# The client's OpenFHE is instrumented: its libraries reference hooks that live
# in libnbfhetch, so every target links it. OPENFHE_CPROBES is defined on every
# target so all stages compile against the same view of the OpenFHE headers.
foreach(prog ${STAGES})
    add_executable(${prog} ${SRC_DIR}/${prog}.cpp)
    target_compile_definitions(${prog} PRIVATE OPENFHE_CPROBES)
    target_include_directories(${prog} PRIVATE ${OPENFHE_INCLUDES})
    target_link_libraries(${prog} PRIVATE ${OpenFHE_SHARED_LIBRARIES} ${NBFHETCH_LIB})
endforeach()

add_executable(diabetes_compute_sdk src/diabetes_compute_sdk.cpp)
target_compile_definitions(diabetes_compute_sdk PRIVATE NIOBIUM_COMPILER OPENFHE_CPROBES
    NB_FHETCH_SIM="${NBFHETCH_LIBDIR}/fhetch_sim")
target_include_directories(diabetes_compute_sdk PRIVATE
    ${SRC_DIR}                                  # common.hpp
    ${NB_FHETCH_DIR}/include
    ${OPENFHE_INCLUDES})
target_link_libraries(diabetes_compute_sdk PRIVATE ${OpenFHE_SHARED_LIBRARIES} ${NBFHETCH_LIB})
